story.titleZh: BP结束F1“流亡”：为何选择与奥迪合作
story.summaryZh: 英国石油公司BP在阔别F1数十年后，将于2026年携润滑油品牌嘉实多重返赛场，与奥迪车队合作。BP高层表示，与一支从零开始进入F1的车队共同成长，是这次合作最具吸引力的地方。
story.originalTitle: Why a fuel giant ended its F1 exile
story.summaryEn: BP has returned to Formula 1 with Audi in 2026 after a decades-long absence, partnering alongside its lubricants brand Castrol. A BP executive says building a partnership with a team entering F1 from the very start is what made the collaboration so attractive.
detailZh: 一级方程式的赞助商如何衡量成功？对于嘉实多母公司英国石油而言——它在长达数十年的缺席后，于2026年携奥迪重返赛场——胜利已经与其润滑油品牌嘉实多一同不断累积。
嘉实多拥有强大的全球赛车运动底蕴——包括近期与阿尔派和迈凯伦合作的一级方程式经验，以及与奥迪合作在世界耐力锦标赛和世界拉力锦标赛上取得的传奇性成功。
"对我们来说，有机会参与一支从零开始进入一级方程式的车队，并共同将其发展壮大，正是这项合作如此具有吸引力的原因，"BP营销与转型高级副总裁妮可拉·巴克解释道。
"这是一个让我们展示技术实力、创新能力以及合作伙伴实力的机会。"
奥迪联盟的深度远远超出了传统的赞助。英国石油公司提供燃油，而嘉实多提供润滑油，这使其成为奥迪2026年厂队参赛项目的基石。
“从技术角度来看，这是一次真正的联合工程之旅，”巴克说，“这不仅仅是贴在车上的一张贴纸。这是一个共同研发动力总成的机会，旨在提供非常独特的产品，希望能为车队带来在赛道上取胜所需的额外动力。”
据巴克所说，奥迪在赛道上的表现——首秀即得分，随后在银石、斯帕和匈牙利又三次跻身前十——已经产生了切实的影响。
“能与我们合作的车队——一支在首个赛季就表现如此出色的车队——建立真正的技术合作伙伴关系，这对品牌的光环效应带来了奇妙的作用，”她指出。
赛道上的出色成绩能直接转化为消费者的信任。巴克解释说，奥迪的竞争力让英国石油和嘉实多能够更好地向大众传达“我们的燃油和润滑油有多么出色，并推销那些我们引以为豪的产品”。
至关重要的是，这次合作还深化了与整个大众集团的商业联系，为向大众旗下的其他制造商供应产品打开了大门。
巴克表示，数据可以证明这一点。2026年3月关于英国石油与奥迪合作的首批报道反响极为积极，这得益于英国石油成为最早为一级方程式新规则时代完成燃油认证的供应商之一。
“我们开展追踪项目，来评估‘这次合作是否帮助我们在世界各地的目标受众中建立与我们品牌的这种关联？’”她说。
英国石油（BP）和嘉实多（Castrol）也会衡量内部反响。
巴克（Buck）说：“我们做这类事情的另一个原因，是为了增强我们组织内部对合作伙伴关系、技术以及我们所拥有的出色产品的自豪感。这一点我们可以很快地进行追踪。”
此外，赛道边的实体展示让两个品牌能够直接与利益相关方互动，无论是通过英国石油（BP）的赛道燃油实验室，还是通过与奥迪（奥迪）F1 车手尼科·霍肯伯格、加布里埃尔·博托莱托，以及 F1 学院（F1 Academy）车手艾玛·费尔伯迈尔（Emma Felbermayr）共同开展的现场活动。
从工程角度来看，英国石油（BP）的赛车运动技术负责人吕克·乔利（Luc Jolly）强调了英国石油（BP）各工程团队之间至关重要且富有价值的信息共享。
乔利解释道：“我们正在借助英国石油（BP）更广泛的技术大脑，获取那些在我的核心团队内部难以完全具备的技能和专业特长。”
“这些共享的经验教训是实实在在的。我们可能还没有谈论所有内容，但在未来几年里，这将成为这段旅程的一部分。”
今年全面的发动机规则修改创造了一个难得的机会。它们为奥迪作为一个全新的动力单元供应商进入提供了一个完美的空白起点，还配备了从零开始打造的专属燃油和润滑剂合作伙伴。
嘉实多与奥迪历史上的成功合作——这一伙伴关系在世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）、德国房车大师赛（DTM）、达喀尔拉力赛和电动方程式（Formula E）等多个赛事中都孕育了胜利——为这笔合作奠定了坚实的基础。
巴克说：“当我们能够与客户交流时，这种一体化关系所带来的可信度——可以谈论历史、传统，以及为什么这是它的下一代——是非常有说服力的。”
乔利对此表示赞同，并指出他们从统治级的LMP1时代延续下来的“组织层面的经验”。
“我们两家组织此前曾与奥迪合作过，我们知道如何彼此配合、互相激发出最好的一面。一些车队成员甚至就是原来那批人。所以，自然会有一种并非从零开始的感觉。”
然而，如果没有自由媒体集团从2017年开始对一级方程式（F1）进行的戏剧性变革，这段合作关系可能根本不会形成。当被问及如果没有F1近年的商业繁荣，英国石油（BP）是否还会重返发车区时，巴克回答道：“我想简单的答案就是不会，对吧？”
“回顾四五年前，F1的观众数量在不断下滑。这项运动当时并不具备如今这样的增长势头。我们甚至曾经质疑是否应该长期参与这项运动。
“现在，从商业角度来看，这意味着观众群体已经发生了巨大变化。这里有一种近乎白纸重绘（blank slate）的元素。
“在这一代17岁、18岁的新车迷中，有很多人对与勒芒（Le Mans）合作的那段历史毫无记忆。对他们来说，这是一项面向未来的、非常现代化的运动呈现方式，我认为我们在传承历史底蕴的同时，完全可以为此感到自豪。”
BP和嘉实多与奥迪合作的真实回报还需要时间来验证——但抓住2026年规则重置、奥迪的F1首秀以及不断增长的F1车迷群体所带来的机遇，已经开始产生红利。
detailEn: How does a Formula 1 sponsor measure success? For BP, which returned to the grid with Audi in 2026 after a decades-long absence, the victories are already stacking up alongside its lubricants brand, Castrol.

Castrol boasts a formidable global motorsport pedigree - including recent F1 experience with Alpine and McLaren, plus legendary World Endurance Championship and World Rally Championship successes with Audi.

"An opportunity for us to be involved in a team that is entering F1 from the start and build that out together is what made this partnership so attractive," explains SVP Marketing and Transformation for BP, Nicola Buck.
"It's an opportunity for us to showcase our technology credentials, our innovation credentials, and our partnership credentials."
The depth of the Audi alliance goes far beyond traditional sponsorship. BP supplies the fuel, while Castrol provides the lubricants, making this a foundational pillar of Audi's 2026 works entry.

"From a technology perspective, it's a true co-engineering journey," Buck says. "This is not just a sticker on a car. It's the opportunity to develop the powertrain together to make a very unique offering that hopefully gives the team the extra power needed to win on the track."
According to Buck, Audi's on-track performance - securing points on debut, followed by three more top-10 finishes across Silverstone, Spa, and Hungary - has already made a tangible impact.
"For us to be in a true technology partnership with a team that's performing so well in its first season, it does wonders for the halo impact on the brand," she notes.

Strong track results translate directly into consumer trust. Buck explains that Audi's competitiveness allows BP and Castrol to better communicate "how brilliant our fuels and lubes are to the general public, and upsell the products that we're so proud of".
Crucially, the partnership also deepens commercial ties with the wider Volkswagen Group, opening doors to supply products across other VW-owned manufacturers.

Buck says the data backs it up. Initial coverage of the BP-Audi partnership in March 2026 was overwhelmingly positive, buoyed by BP being among the first suppliers to homologate its fuel for F1's new regulatory era.
"We run tracking programmes to say, 'Is that partnership helping us build that association with our brand amongst our target audiences around the world?'" she says.
BP and Castrol also measure internal optics.

"Another reason we do this kind of thing is to build pride in our organisation for the partnerships, the technology, and the amazing products we've got. And that we can track very quickly," Buck says.

Furthermore, a physical trackside presence allows both brands to engage stakeholders directly, whether through BP's trackside fuel lab or via activations with Audi F1 drivers Nico Hulkenberg and Gabriel Bortoleto, alongside F1 Academy driver Emma Felbermayr.
From an engineering standpoint, BP's motorsport technology lead, Luc Jolly, highlights the crucial and useful sharing of information between BP's engineering teams.
"We're tapping into the wider BP technology brain for skills and specialisms that would be difficult to have completely within my core team," Jolly explains.
"The shared learnings are real. We might not be talking about all of them yet, but that's going to be part of this journey over the coming years."

This year's sweeping engine regulation changes created a rare opening. They provided the perfect blank slate for Audi to enter as a new powertrain supplier, complete with dedicated, ground-up fuel and lubricant partners.
Castrol's historical success with Audi - a partnership that has bred victories across numerous disciplines such as the WEC, DTM, Dakar Rally, and Formula E - laid a solid foundation for the deal.

"When we're able to talk to customers, the credibility of having that joined-up relationship - to talk about the history, the heritage, and why this is the next generation of it - is really powerful," Buck says.
Jolly agrees, noting the "organisational learnings" that carried over from their dominant LMP1 days.

"Having worked with Audi previously, as two organisations, we know how to work together and get the best out of each other. Some of the team members are actually the same. So, there's a natural sense of not starting from scratch."

However, the partnership might never have materialised without Liberty Media's dramatic transformation of F1 that began in 2017. When asked if BP would have returned to the grid without F1's recent commercial boom, Buck replied: "I think the simple answer is no, right?
"You go back four or five years, F1 numbers were declining. It wasn't a sport that had the growth that it has today. It was a sport that we were questioning our involvement in for the long term.
"Now, what that translates to from a business perspective is that the audience has dramatically shifted. There is an element of a blank slate.

"There are many in this new generation of 17- and 18-year-old fans who have no memory of the Le Mans partnership. For them, it's a very modern take on a sport for the future that I think we can be really proud of, as well as building off that heritage."

It will take time to find out the real returns of BP and Castrol's partnership with Audi - but the capitalisation on the 2026 rules reset, Audi's F1 debut, and a growing F1 fanbase, is already paying dividends.
keyPointsZh: BP的润滑油品牌嘉实多此前曾与阿尔派和迈凯伦有过F1合作经验，并在世界耐力锦标赛和世界拉力锦标赛中与奥迪有过辉煌战绩。
keyPointsEn: Castrol previously had F1 experience with Alpine and McLaren, plus successful World Endurance Championship and World Rally Championship history with Audi.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.

国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
